description: Use this first when the user asks about Canadian bank accounts (currently chequing at the banks listed in coverage), or which accounts a bank offers. Returns every product in BLIA's snapshot with its product_slug, its variants (customer groups such as seniors, each with its eligibility note), the attributes published, and completeness. coverage says what BLIA does and does not cover; an empty result always says why. Filters combine. Pages hold up to 50 products; pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page (null on the last). Free tier: published values only -- no source citation, provenance tier or corroboration status. Not for fees or rules: take a product_slug from here to get_product_terms or compare_products.

cursor.description: product_slug returned as next_cursor by a prior call

institution.description: Institution id as listed in coverage.institutions_covered (bmo, cibc, rbc, scotia, td: the Big 5); a common or legal name such as BMO, RBC, Scotiabank or Royal Bank of Canada also resolves. Omit for all.

product_class.description: Product class. Only "chequing" is covered today.

province.description: Province: a two-letter code (ON, QC, ...) or a name such as Ontario or Québec; omit for all provinces.

name: list_bank_products

as_of.description: When the snapshot was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

coverage.description: What BLIA does and does not cover: product classes, institutions, kinds of information.

coverage_scope.description: The product class, institutions and lineup completeness the snapshot covers.

disclaimer.description: BLIA's disclaimer, verbatim. Include it when relaying values.

as_of.description: When the snapshot was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

guidance.description: What to say and what to confirm with the institution at this age.

status.description: How old the snapshot is: current up to 30 days, aging up to 90, then stale.

freshness_warning.description: Repeats freshness.guidance when the snapshot is not current.

publication_seq.description: Publication number of the snapshot being served.
